scope: China continental shale oil (Chang 7 / Qingshankou / Lucaogou) + North American analogues; field-scale geomechanics, petrophysics and stimulation parameters used to recompute RATE_FRACABILITY_ROADMAP.md tables A-C.
unit_convention: 1 mD = 1e-3 um^2 = 1e-15 m^2 (engineering approximation); 1 MPa.sqrt(m) = 1e6 Pa.sqrt(m); 1 mPa.s = 1e-3 Pa.s; 1 MPa^-1 = 1e-6 Pa^-1.
honesty: These are published ranges, NOT block-specific measurements. k_core (core gas permeability) and k_eff (pressure-decline inverted effective matrix permeability) differ by ~2 decades and must never be interchanged. S is DERIVED from phi*(c_f+c_l), not measured directly. Nothing here may be used for field rate selection without DFIT/mini-frac calibration.

E_static.note: Static Young modulus. 8.2-13.0 GPa triaxial static (Qingshankou), 14.72-34.58 GPa at 30 MPa confining (Chang 7 block Y, mean 23.77), 16.26-59.12 GPa (southern Chang 7). Dynamic ultrasonic moduli are 25-31 GPa and must NOT be mixed with static ones.

nu_static.note: Static Poisson ratio. Qingshankou triaxial 0.16-0.21; Chang 7 block Y 0.106-0.288 mean 0.182.

KIC.note: Southern Chang 7 core 0.2-1.2 MPa.sqrt(m). Sichuan marine shale SCB spans 0.43-1.88 depending on bedding angle (S15) - that is a different play and is used only for the anisotropy ratio.

k_core.note: Core / log gas permeability 0.01-0.14 mD. Chang 7 (0.11-0.14)e-3 um2; most basins <1e-3 um2. NOT the permeability controlling leak-off.

k_eff.note: Effective matrix permeability from pressure-decline / DFIT inversion: Junggar X1 0.001-0.002 mD; Jimsar shut-in model 0.01 mD; Montney DFIT 0.024 mD. This is the value that belongs in T and C_L.

phi.note: Chang 7 6-12%; lacustrine shale oil basins 3-16%; Jimsar model 10%.

c_pore.note: Pore compressibility 0.001-0.136 MPa^-1 (Lu Zhou shale gas), mean 0.1145 MPa^-1 at Fuji syncline. Largest uncertainty in the whole table (2 decades).

c_fluid.note: Water 4.4e-4 MPa^-1 and oil 3.6e-3 MPa^-1 in the Jimsar shut-in model.

S.note: DERIVED as phi*(c_pore+c_fluid); not a direct measurement. The B0 deck value S_num=1.5e-10 Pa^-1 lies inside this band.

mu.note: Variable-viscosity slickwater 1-60 mPa.s; low 1-3, high 12-20, ultra-high >=60 mPa.s; Jimsar water phase 3.6 mPa.s. The old roadmap assumed clear water 1e-3 Pa.s.

delta_p.note: SINGLE-POINT ENGINEERING ASSUMPTION carried over from roadmap 4.2 (net pressure for C_L inversion), NOT a literature measurement and NOT a scanned dimension: low==high==rep is enforced by M1. It is the least constrained quantity in this table. Sensitivity probe (not a param): with 10 MPa instead, the high corner gives C~0.10, i.e. still below the leakoff-dominated O(1) regime but approaching it; see RATE_FRACABILITY_ROADMAP.md section 14.

delta_sigma.note: Horizontal stress difference: Chang 7 1.9-7.2 MPa mean 4.8 MPa (85 stress tests); Qingshankou / Lucaogou <10 MPa.

H_f.note: Net pay / fracture height: Qingshankou oil layer 20-100 m, Lucaogou 20-50 m, Jimsar shut-in model reservoir thickness 42 m. Old roadmap assumed 50 m.

t_f.note: Single-stage pump time: Jimsar model 2 h per stage; old roadmap assumed 1 h.

Q.note: Chang 7 main treatment 10-12 m3/min (S03), optimized 10-14 m3/min (S04), direct ramp to 12 m3/min for laminated felsic shale (S20). Old roadmap scanned 4-20 m3/min.

clusters_per_stage.note: 4-6 clusters/stage in Chang 7; 7-9 for laminated felsic shale, 5-7 for calcareous shale.

cluster_spacing.note: Reduced from 20-30 m to 5-10 m by subdivision cutting.

fluid_per_stage.note: Chang 7 ~1300 m3/stage; Jimsar model 1575 m3/stage; older tight-oil practice 1100 m3.

well_spacing.note: 300-400 m current; older tight-oil demonstration 500-600 m.

pressure_coefficient.note: Chang 7 abnormally low 0.77-0.84; rises to ~1.3 after fracturing due to retained fluid; Qingshankou / Lucaogou >1.2.

brittleness_index.note: Chang 7 14.6-71.5% mean 43.5%; mineral-based MBI 0.539 in block Y.

KIC_anisotropy_ratio.note: Mancos divider/arrester ~1.8x short-transverse; Sichuan marine shale 1.88/0.43=4.37x across bedding angle. B2 deck uses 2/0.5=4x, i.e. near the upper literature bound.

closure_stress_min.note: Minimum horizontal stress 12-38 MPa (southern Chang 7); Montney DFIT closure 34.4-39.3 MPa. Only an offset in this platform, see roadmap 4.1.

legacy_envelope.comment: First-edition roadmap table A/B/C four synthetic shale classes (assumed, NOT measured).

window.comment: Two disjoint setups. 'legacy' reproduces the FIRST-edition tables A-C from RATE_FRACABILITY_ROADMAP.md 4.2 and is the calibration anchor for the recomputation script. 'literature' maps the published parameter names to the field quantities used by the new recomputation. Never mix values between them.

literature.comment: Field quantities are taken from params by NAME, not hardcoded. The numerical platform constants stay frozen at the Gate 4.15 B0 values.

formulas.comment: Exponents and prefactors of the dimensionless scalings in RATE_FRACABILITY_ROADMAP.md 2.3. Stored here so the verdict can falsify any silent formula drift. K_prefactor = 4/sqrt(pi) and C_prefactor = 2 are the OUTER factors of the printed formulas; the inner constants 3 and 12 are stored separately so that the literal form and the expanded power-law form must agree to machine precision.

numerical.comment: Gate 4.15 B0 frozen similarity constants (CI #125), untouched by this literature study.
